CORA: (dry) A plain vocabulary word.
EDWIN: (dryly) A synonym for dry.
EDWIN: (softly) A synonym for tender.
EDWIN: (stubbornly) A synonym for tense.
EDWIN: (reverberating) A sound note, ignored.
EDWIN: (a little amused) Intensity rides on the emotion.
EDWIN: (very tense) Intensity three.
CORA: (weary, very, slow) Full grammar, any order of the tail.
CORA: (urgent, quick) Pace only after the emotion.
CORA: (slow) Pace alone, no emotion at all.
CORA: (approaching) An unknown direction, reported.
CORA: (laughs) A leading non-verbal is not a direction.
CORA: (laughs) (dryly) Non-verbal first, then a direction (sighs) and one inside.
EDWIN: Words (gasps) with a non-verbal and (waving) a stray inline one.
